items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Who was the guitar player with Robichaux before you? Um, Kitcher Martin.

ctx.x: Who was the guitar player before you?

Yeah. Who was the guitar player with Robichaux before you? Um, Kitcher Martin. You know what I'm talking about? And his brother was playing drums, you know. Uh, but his brother wasn't playing drums, Kitcher Martin was playing with Rose, but he had to leave Kitcher Martin to lose, and Timman, Henry Timman, let him lose, and, uh, ! Yeah, Tyler McCurdy. Yeah, Tyler McCurdy. And he was, he was a professor, Tyler, and he could play, but he couldn't hear him good. He's soft. He couldn't blow loud. Yeah. Never talked,…
Well, who was the next clarinet player after, could you, after Charlie McCurdy?
